metadata.scenario: A returning customer calls to cancel their membership as they are relocating abroad. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Rose Patterson. I hope you’re doing well. Hi Rose! I’m doing well, thank you. How can I help you today? Well, I’m calling to discuss something important... I need to cancel our services. I’m sorry to hear that. Can I ask what’s prompting the cancellation? We’re relocating abroad. It’s a big move for us, and I just can’t keep the services. I completely understand, Rose. That must be a difficult decision. How long do you expect to be away? We’ll be moving permanently, so it’s definitely a big change for us and for Mom. That’s understandable. Your mom has been with us for 18 months now, and we’ve really enjoyed having her. Thank you, I really appreciate the care she’s received. It’s been such a relief. I’m glad to hear that. Would you like me to go ahead and process the cancellation now? Yes, please. I just want to make sure everything is taken care of. Absolutely. I’ll need to confirm the last date of services. When would you like that to be? Well, her caregivers are scheduled for daily visits this week, so perhaps the end of the week? That works. I’ll process the cancellation effective this Friday. Thank you. I also want to ensure that her caregiver knows she’s moving. Of course! I’ll make a note for her caregiver to have a final visit and say goodbye. That’s perfect, thank you. I really want Mom to have closure with her caregivers. Absolutely, Rose. We’ll take care of that. And what about the billing? Will that be affected? Your final invoice will reflect services through Friday, and there shouldn’t be any additional charges. Great, that’s a relief. If you need any help during the transition, feel free to reach out. I appreciate that. One last thing, if you ever return to Wichita, we’d love to welcome you back! Absolutely, I’ll keep that in mind. Thank you for calling, Rose. We wish you and your family the best of luck! Thank you, Margaret. Take care! You too! Goodbye.
